title: news signal
description: Headlines from the RSS 2.0 / Atom feed at providers.news.url, fetched every 15 min. GET /api/signals/news, polled every 10 min; 404 unless providers.news.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. Not sensitive.

items.description: Headlines in feed order (newest first for most feeds), at most providers.news.max_items.

at.description: Publication time. Unix time in seconds (float). Null if the feed gives none.
When the feed was fetched. Unix time in seconds (float).
